2026-10-20.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Updated bone armour crafting recipe to match intended values and swapped egg vision effect to candy vision.
Prevented jumping while crouched when a solid object is directly above, fixing head clipping and unintended explosion damage.
Fixed gravestone collider to use the correct convex shape, improving physics impacts.
Fixed Cursed Cauldron collider issues by removing an unused mesh collider and correcting the building‑prevent collider layer.
Assigned proper physics materials to Wooden Cross, Skull Fire Pit, and Spooky Speaker, correcting their physical behavior.
Fixed Frankenstein pet ignoring player shields, restoring correct shield interaction.
Fixed NPC corpses becoming unlootable after a server restart, restoring loot access.
Fixed scarecrows sometimes not spawning in Halloween dungeon corridors.
Fixed radiation starting immediately upon entering Halloween and Christmas dungeons, ensuring proper radiation timing.
Added a DungeonGridBlocker to canyon areas to stop underground train tunnels from spawning too close and removing terrain collision, preventing rare deaths at canyon bottoms.
Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo's living quarters and computer room, fixing players and NPCs disappearing/reappearing on the stairs.
Fixed the Frankenstein pet sinking into terrain, performing invisible ranged attacks, occasionally kicking its owner, and passing through windows.
Fixed merged animation controllers and the livestock FSM, restoring correct animal behavior.
Corrected MeshCull to properly hide its renderer when reused from the pool while culled, preventing code‑lock light quads from being visible at any distance after spawning.
Fixed group‑change polling bugs that could affect entity grouping logic.
Fixed gamepad glyph panel overlapping inventory UI on certain resolutions/aspects.
Added a separate 'currently craftable' list and an 'All' button; category buttons now toggle groups, improving crafting UI navigation.
Adjusted fruit tree spawn mechanics: coconut trees now have reduced network range (128) and spawn chance corrected to 25%; apple and beehive spawn chance on oak trees increased to 25%.
Lighthouses now share a common resource and repair progress pool, allowing multiple lighthouses to contribute to the same upgrade.
Various physics and collision fixes (ambient lights, gravestone colliders, Cursed Cauldron collisions, and physics materials) improve performance and prevent unexpected impacts.
Added a second layer override to the nuclear missile silo and a tunnel blocker in canyon areas, preventing disappearing players/NPCs on stairs and rare deaths from underground train tunnels.
Scarecrows now always spawn in Halloween dungeon corridors and radiation no longer activates immediately on entry, giving players time to react.
Adjusted fruit tree spawn mechanics: coconut trees have reduced network range, spawn chances corrected, and apple/beehive spawn rates on oak trees increased to 25%.
All lighthouses now share a common repair progress, so multiple lighthouses contribute to and reflect the same repair status.
Jumping while crouched under a solid object is now prevented, stopping head clipping and unintended explosion damage.
Frankenstein pet now respects player shields and no longer sinks, become invisible, kick the owner, or pass through windows.
NPC corpses are lootable after a server restart, restoring expected loot drops from dead enemies.
Cooking UI overhaul adds a separate list for craftable items, an "All" button, and toggle groups for categories.
Fixed mouse cursor flicker when scrolling UI with the right stick and resolved gamepad UI overlap issues in inventory.
Fixed artifacting on cargo mapmarkers and corrected particle system culling, eliminating distant visual glitches and improving performance.
Cooking workbench now correctly displays the kettle when preparing the newly added teas, ensuring players can see the brewing process.
Code lock light indicators no longer persist at extreme distances after spawning, fixing misleading visual cues.

2026-10-19.summary:
### Gameplay & World Fixes
- Various physics and collision fixes (ambient lights, gravestone colliders, Cursed Cauldron collisions, and physics materials) improve performance and prevent unexpected impacts.
- Added a second layer override to the nuclear missile silo and a tunnel blocker in canyon areas, preventing disappearing players/NPCs on stairs and rare deaths from underground train tunnels.
- Scarecrows now always spawn in Halloween dungeon corridors and radiation no longer activates immediately on entry, giving players time to react.
- Adjusted fruit tree spawn mechanics: coconut trees have reduced network range, spawn chances corrected, and apple/beehive spawn rates on oak trees increased to 25%.
- All lighthouses now share a common repair progress, so multiple lighthouses contribute to and reflect the same repair status.

### Player Mechanics & Combat
- Jumping while crouched under a solid object is now prevented, stopping head clipping and unintended explosion damage.
- Frankenstein pet now respects player shields and no longer sinks, become invisible, kick the owner, or pass through windows.

### NPC & Loot
- NPC corpses are lootable after a server restart, restoring expected loot drops from dead enemies.

### UI & Controls Improvements
- Cooking UI overhaul adds a separate list for craftable items, an "All" button, and toggle groups for categories.
- Fixed mouse cursor flicker when scrolling UI with the right stick and resolved gamepad UI overlap issues in inventory.

### Visual & Audio Polish
- Fixed artifacting on cargo mapmarkers and corrected particle system culling, eliminating distant visual glitches and improving performance.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Cooking workbench now correctly displays the kettle when preparing the newly added teas, ensuring players can see the brewing process.
- Code lock light indicators no longer persist at extreme distances after spawning, fixing misleading visual cues.

items.text: Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.
Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.
Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.
